method: Rows 1-15 of ~/codewatch-research/gaps/misses.tsv, in the file's order (the file holds only cve-pairs-php cases today; no Python or JavaScript case was in it, so the PHP group was taken first as section 9 requires). All 15 were confirmed present as open cases in the cve-pairs-php suite. For each case the fix commit's diff was fetched with the GitHub API, and where the diff did not show the source, the sink or the way between them, the parent commit's files were fetched too: opnsense LogController.php and Diagnostics/log.volt + Cron/ItemController.php and Cron/index.volt, pimcore AssetController.php (import and zip regions) and GridHelperService.php/QueryParams.php, dynacase freedomrss_search.php, ipandlanguageredirect LocalDatabase.php/AbstractIpToCountry.php/RedirectController.php/RedirectService.php, PsychoStats login.php and acp/login.html, monitor-ninja controllers/schedule.php and scheduled_reports.php, mh_httpbl mod1/index.php, moodle mod/wiki/classes/external.php and mod/wiki/locallib.php, concretecms account/messages.php controller and single page, SemanticMediaWiki TimeValueFormatter.php and Query/Result/ResultArray.php, debug-bar class-debug-bar-queries.php, osticket ajax.php/include/ajax.staff.php/templates/quick-add.tmpl.php/dispatcher. Each advisory's description was read from GitHub's advisories API. Every note was read from the fix's parent side. 15 cases noted of 152 rows in misses.tsv, all of them PHP; 137 are left for the next runs.

notes.source: src/opnsense/mvc/app/controllers/OPNsense/Diagnostics/LogController.php:74-79 `__call($name, $arguments)` reads the action name as the module (`substr($name, 0, -6)`) and the first dispatch argument as the scope, i.e. the two path segments of `/ui/diagnostics/log/<module>/<scope>`
notes.sink: src/opnsense/mvc/app/views/OPNsense/Diagnostics/log.volt:77 `search:'/api/diagnostics/log/{{module}}/{{scope}}'` inside the page's inline <script>, plus the same two values at :40, :81, :128 in localStorage keys and URLs
notes.between: LogController::__call() -> renderPage($module, $scope) (:38) assigns both to the view (:41-42); Phalcon's dispatcher hands the URL segments to __call with no route declaration, and the Volt template interpolates them into JavaScript string literals
notes.fix: htmlspecialchars($module/$scope, ENT_QUOTES|ENT_HTML401) in renderPage before assigning them to the view
notes.probe:
<?php
// Phalcon MVC: /ui/diagnostics/log/{module}/{scope} reaches __call as action + argument
class LogController extends \Phalcon\Mvc\Controller
{
    public function __call($name, $arguments)
    {
        $module = substr($name, 0, -6);
        $scope = $arguments[0];
        $this->view->module = $module;
        $this->view->scope = $scope;
    }
}
?>
<script>
  $("#grid-log").UIBootgrid({ search: '/api/diagnostics/log/<?= $module ?>/<?= $scope ?>' });
</script>

<?php
// TYPO3 Extbase plugin: tx_myext_pi1[ipAddress]=...
public function redirectAction(string $ipAddress = '')
{
    if ($ipAddress === '') {
        $ipAddress = \TYPO3\CMS\Core\Utility\GeneralUtility::getIndpEnv('REMOTE_ADDR');

         . ' where inet_aton("' . $ipAddress . '") >= inet_aton(ipRangeStart) limit 1';
    $country = $this->connection->query($sql)->fetchColumn(0);
}
